name: WP Airbnb Review Slider
author: jgwhite33

sections.description:
Display Airbnb Guest Reviews on Your WordPress Website in Minutes — Fast, Local & Built for Direct Bookings.

WP Airbnb Review Slider downloads your Airbnb vacation rental, room, and Airbnb Experience reviews and stores them directly in your WordPress database (utf8mb4 emoji-ready) on your own server. Instead of slowing down your site with external scripts on every page load, your property pages serve guest reviews locally for fast page speed, strong Core Web Vitals, and seamless caching.

Whether you manage a single short-term rental, multiple vacation homes, or hospitality experiences, showcasing real Airbnb guest testimonials, reviewer avatars, and an Airbnb rating summary badge next to your booking calendar builds instant social proof and helps drive more direct bookings.

Here’s a quick video of setting up Airbnb reviews in less than 2 minutes!

Why Choose WP Airbnb Review Slider?

  • Supports Airbnb Stays & Experiences: Import guest reviews from Airbnb room/property URLs (airbnb.com/rooms/...) and Airbnb Experience URLs (airbnb.com/experiences/...).
  • Add Multiple Airbnb Listings: Save multiple Airbnb listing URLs on the Get Airbnb Reviews page, download reviews for each property, and assign each review template to display the right listing on the right property page.
  • Airbnb Summary Rating Badge: Place a customizable Airbnb rating badge on the left, right, or above your reviews (or show the badge standalone) displaying the saved listing average rating and total review count.
  • Built-In Review Analytics Dashboard: Explore your average star rating, rating distribution, review volume timeline, rating trends over time, and positive/negative keyword word clouds inside wp-admin.
  • Stored Locally on Your Server: Reviews load directly from your WordPress database for top performance and reliability.

Key Features (Free Version)

  • Responsive Review Slider, Carousel, Grid & List: Display Airbnb guest reviews in an animated horizontal slider or a multi-row, multi-column responsive grid.
  • Two Template Styles + Live Preview: Choose between Style 1 (classic speech bubble) and Style 6 (modern review card layout) in a tabbed template editor (Style, General, Filter, Badge) with live AJAX preview and save.
  • Multi-Listing Source Management: Add multiple Airbnb property URLs, view each listing’s average rating and total review count, and choose which listing source a template displays.
  • Review List & Inline Editing: View all imported Airbnb reviews in one list. Easily hide/show individual reviews, edit reviewer avatars and review dates inline, or delete reviews.
  • Review Photos & Lightbox: View and display review media thumbnails that open in a full-size lightbox popup when clicked.
  • Smart Template Filtering: Filter reviews by minimum star rating, hide reviews without text, sort by newest or random order, and filter by Airbnb listing source.
  • Full Design Customization: Customize star colors, verified review badges, guest last name format (full name, hidden, or initial), avatar style (guest photo, mystery icon, initials, or hidden), Airbnb icon link, font sizes, background/text colors, border radius, and custom CSS.
  • Slider & Layout Controls: Configure autoplay, slide speed and delay, show/hide navigation arrows and dots, mobile swipe support, one-review-per-slide mobile option, equal-height review cards (Reviews Same Height), and expandable Read More links.
  • Display Anywhere: Embed unlimited review templates on property pages, landing pages, homepages, or sidebars using the WP Airbnb Review Slider block, a shortcode, a WordPress widget, or a PHP template function.

Check Out Our Other Free Review Slider Plugins

  • Google Reviews
  • Facebook & X (Twitter) Reviews
  • Yelp Reviews
  • TripAdvisor Reviews
  • Thumbtack Reviews
  • Zillow Reviews
  • WooCommerce Product Reviews

Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro for More Features

Want to combine Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, TripAdvisor, and Google reviews into one unified display and sync automatically every day? Upgrade to WP Review Slider Pro:

  • 150+ Review Sites (Including VRBO, Booking.com, TripAdvisor & Google): Import and combine reviews from Airbnb, VRBO, Booking.com, TripAdvisor, Expedia, Hotels.com, Google, Facebook, Yelp, Hostelworld, GetYourGuide, InnStyle, Trustpilot, Zillow, Thumbtack, WooCommerce, and 130+ more platforms!
  • Daily Automatic Sync & Full Review History: Set a daily cron schedule to automatically check for new Airbnb reviews and download more reviews per listing.
  • Combine Multiple Listings in One Template: Mix guest reviews across all of your Airbnb properties (and VRBO/Google listings) into an overall company testimonial slider, or filter dynamically by Post ID, Category, or custom tags.
  • Custom Review Sources & AI Import: Add any custom booking or review platform with your own logo, and use AI to extract and import reviews automatically.
  • AI Review Summaries & Deep AI Analysis: Display an AI-generated “Guests Say” summary in your template header or badge, run full AI Sentiment & SWOT Analysis reports (themes, pain points, guest personas, and action items), and draft AI Host Responses.
  • 15 Review Template Styles & Masonry Grids: Unlock 15 template styles, Masonry grids, continuous-scroll carousels, custom responsive breakpoints, and child-theme template overrides.
  • Interactive Front-End Header, Search & Pagination: Add a front-end search bar, sort dropdown, rating/source filter, tag filter pills, Load More button, Endless Scroll, or numbered pagination.
  • 7 Summary Badge Styles, Floating Badges & Slide-Out Drawers: Choose from 7 standalone badge designs, pin floating badges or review pop-ins to the corner of your site, and open a slide-out or pop-up review drawer on click.
  • Direct Guest Review Submission Forms & Smart Review Gate: Collect direct-booking guest reviews on your site with custom fields, photo/video uploads, and reCAPTCHA.
  • Automated Review Request Emails (Autoresponders): Send automatic post-stay or post-order review request emails with open/click tracking.
  • Shareable Social Media Review Cards & Email Signatures: Turn guest reviews into high-resolution PNG social graphics (with Google Fonts & Unsplash backgrounds) and build live-rating email signatures.
  • Google Rich Snippet Schema (JSON-LD), Auto-Translate, Webhooks & White-Label: Output JSON-LD AggregateRating schema markup, auto-translate international guest reviews via Google Translate API, send reviews to Zapier, Make, or n8n via webhooks, sync with TrustGuide, import/export CSVs, and enable Agency White-Label Mode.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the wp-airbnb-review-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install WP Airbnb Review Slider from Plugins → Add New in WordPress.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open WP Airbnb in your WordPress admin menu.
  4. Go to Get Airbnb Reviews, add one or more Airbnb listing URLs (airbnb.com/rooms/... or airbnb.com/experiences/...), and click Download Reviews.
  5. Visit Review List and Analytics to inspect your imported guest reviews and rating charts.
  6. Create a template on the Templates page, then insert the WP Airbnb Review Slider block or add the shortcode to any property page, post, or widget area.
sections.faq:
Are Airbnb reviews stored on my server?

Yes. When you download reviews, they are saved in your WordPress database on your own server. Your website serves those reviews locally instead of calling Airbnb on every page view, keeping your property pages fast and cache-friendly.

Can I use this for multiple Airbnb listings?

Yes! On the Get Airbnb Reviews page, you can add multiple Airbnb listing URLs and download reviews for each property. In the free version, each review template can display reviews for one chosen Airbnb listing (so you can place each property’s reviews on its own page). In WP Review Slider Pro, you can also combine multiple Airbnb listings (plus VRBO, Booking.com, and Google reviews) into a single combined slider and auto-sync daily.

Does this work with Airbnb Experiences as well as vacation rentals?

Yes. You can add both Airbnb room/property URLs (https://www.airbnb.com/rooms/...) and Airbnb Experience URLs (https://www.airbnb.com/experiences/...).

Can I display an Airbnb rating summary badge?

Yes. Each template includes a Badge settings tab that lets you display an Airbnb summary badge (with your listing’s saved average rating, total review count, and a link to your Airbnb listing) on the left, right, or top of your reviews — or standalone.

Can I hide specific reviews or filter by star rating?

Yes. You can hide individual reviews with one click on the Review List page, or set a minimum star rating filter in your template settings.

How do I request a new feature?

Post on the support forum or contact us on the WP Review Slider website.
